metric_protocol.aggregation: Unweighted case mean within each dimension; every planned pair retained; unavailable metrics invalidate aggregate, never silently dropped
scope: Purposive business-relevant demonstration, no population weights or business coverage percentage.
Ten easy and ten hard tables deliberately oversample hard cases; additional hard cases concentrate on insurance.
Page excerpts do not measure whole-document completion or operational invoice extraction.
Local text-layer parsers have no OCR; scanned inputs remain eligible.
